relatedEntities.name: EAAA India Alternatives
relatedEntities.note: Edelweiss disclosed EAAA India Alternatives (formerly Edelweiss Alternative Asset Advisors) filing its DRHP. This is the related issuer’s IPO, not an Edelweiss Financial Services IPO or confirmation of an opening date.

relatedEntities.name: Neco Defence Munitions
relatedEntities.note: JNIL states that Neco Defence shares promoters and a director but is not its subsidiary, associate or joint venture; JNIL states it has no transactions with it and no financial impact.

relatedEntities.name: Datasel
relatedEntities.note: JNIL identifies Datasel as a subsidiary of Neco Defence, not JNIL. The company denies transactions or financial impact for JNIL; allegations about Datasel must not be restated as findings against JNIL.
